messages:
Olivia Park: hey everyone, quick onboarding ask  i'm scheduled to shadow CS next week and need access to the customer-sandbox project + sample anonymized dataset. who owns approvals for sandbox data + any legal checklist i should follow?
Sam Turner: welcome Olivia! people-ops routes sandbox access but if it touches customer data we need Legal sign-off. file the "Sandbox Access" form and tag @legal-compliance.
Olivia Park: thanks Sam  is there a short checklist for what anonymization proof we need? or a template to attach?
Mina Gupta: hi Olivia  Legal here. for sandboxed customer data we need: 1) data schema note, 2) proof of anonymization (hashing/pseudonymization), 3) purpose and timebox. use the Legal Request template and attach the data handling doc.
Olivia Park: got it. is the timebox usually 30 days?
Mina Gupta: default is 14 days for onboarding/shadowing, extend with justification. keep it minimal and include product owner as approver.
Olivia Park: awesome. two more things: 1) for demo recordings (video of product flows) do I need customer opt-in? 2) who approves a short dedicated capacity trial for a local model test?
Jenna Li: hi Olivia  demo recordings that include customer-identifiable info need opt-in. sanitized UX-only clips are usually fine. if in doubt, ask CS lead and Legal.
Carlos Vega: capacity trial = eng-platform. small short trials (<=2 GPUs for a week) we can fast-track; anything that hits reserved pools needs eng-platform + finance signoff. file "Dedicated Trial" on infra board with estimated hours and cost center.
Olivia Park: perfect. and for the sandbox request, who is the person that actually provisions the project?
Sam Turner: people-ops will kick the flow but eng-ml infra does the provisioning. we'll loop @carlos for the compute and @it-security for vault keys.
IT Security Bot: automation: data-risk scan required. Please attach the anonymization checklist and run `datacheck --scan sandbox_bucket` prior to provisioning.
Olivia Park: thanks  i'll run the scan. small nit  does the infra template need the repo/service tag or the CS case id?
Carlos Vega: include both if available: repo/service tag (e.g., svc:cs-playback) and cs_case_id. that speeds validation.
Olivia Park: filing the forms now.:writing_hand: will post ticket links when done.
Olivia Park: (update) filed SANDBOX-0172 and TRIAL-331 (demo trial). SANDBOX-0172 link: https://tickets.redwood/SANDBOX-0172
Mina Gupta: legal acked SANDBOX-0172 pending anonymization proof.
Carlos Vega: TRIAL-331 is in eng-platform queue, tagging finance for cost approval. expect ~1 business day.
Jenna Li: i'll sync with CS lead on opt-in for any clip that references a customer. keep me posted.
Olivia Park: thanks all! last thing  if i need emergency access while shadowing (e.g., watch a live session), who signs off for a 2-hour window?
Sam Turner: emergency access = people-ops + oncall lead. file "Emergency Access" with timebox=2h and label "shadowing"; we'll fast-track.
Olivia Park: perfect  closing once I have the sandbox keys. really appreciate the help :pray:
